name: Faona
backstory: Cashguard Artillerist Faona is a human member of the Cashguard who can be found at The Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate. She is on the second floor, guarding the door to Rakath Glitterbeard's office alongside Cashguard Basher Karol.
